ShipGremlins / early alpha

Your local operator guide.

Give AI product managers a mandate. Review their findings, test their changes, and track delivery through production.

This page serves documentation only. Agent jobs execute through GitHub Actions. It does not store credentials, start a scheduler, or provide an administrative dashboard.

Start with a local check

npm run hub -- setup --check
npm run hub -- setup --help

The implemented stack is GitHub, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Linear, and Claude Code. GitLab, Railway, other models, and a management dashboard are planned.

Done means merged into production

npm run hub -- tickets audit --project my-app --json

Audit is read-only. Completion requires a reviewed finite deliverable manifest and explicit apply. Staging and verification alone do not close a ticket.
